in_sanskrit.name: Sovon
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Wisdom, Intelligence
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Sovon एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Sovon is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sarvan', which means 'all' or 'universal'. The name Sovon signifies the one who possesses all the wisdom and intelligence. This name is also associated with the Hindu god Saraswati, who is the goddess of knowledge, music, and wisdom.
